project_name: Microsoft Finland cloud region - Espoo campus
source_title: Microsoft käynnistää pääkaupunkiseudun datakeskusalueen toisen vaiheen rakentamisen
evidence_excerpt: Three-campus Microsoft datacenter region includes Espoo; first-phase works started in late 2024.
notes: Treat Espoo as one physical campus within a multi-campus Finland cloud region. Microsoft source supports project execution and second-phase construction decision; separate ELY/YVA material supports a 200 MW full-site electrical-power claim, not IT load.

project_name: Microsoft Finland cloud region - Kirkkonummi campus
source_title: Microsoft käynnistää pääkaupunkiseudun datakeskusalueen toisen vaiheen rakentamisen
evidence_excerpt: Three-campus Microsoft datacenter region includes Kirkkonummi; first-phase works started in late 2024.
notes: Treat Kirkkonummi as one physical campus within a multi-campus Finland cloud region. Microsoft source supports project execution and second-phase construction decision; separate municipal/YVA material supports a 150 MW full-site electrical-power claim, not IT load.

project_name: Microsoft Finland cloud region - Vihti campus
source_title: Microsoft käynnistää pääkaupunkiseudun datakeskusalueen toisen vaiheen rakentamisen
evidence_excerpt: Three-campus Microsoft datacenter region includes Vihti; first-phase works started in late 2024.
notes: Treat Vihti as one physical campus within a multi-campus Finland cloud region. source_title: Googles datacenter tillkännagav att de kommer att påbörja sin sjunde expansion i Hamina
evidence_excerpt: Hamina city says Google will start the seventh expansion of its Hamina datacenter.
notes: Operational campus opened in 2011; 2024 source covers seventh expansion and heat-reuse project. No public MW claim found.

source_title: Data Center in Kouvola Finland
evidence_excerpt: YIT lists the Kouvola Hyperco project as under construction with completion scheduled for May 2027.
notes: TikTok is the announced tenant in separate TikTok source; YIT names the project Data Center Blackhawk and customer Hyperco Fin HoldCo 1 Oy. Separate EIA material supports an approx. 100 MW IT-load claim.

source_title: TikTok investoi miljardin Lahden datakeskukseen
evidence_excerpt: Lahti city says DayOne will build the Kiveriö datacenter and TikTok is the anchor customer.
notes: Project source says SRV starts construction in spring 2026 and operations are intended during 2027. MW claims are in separate lower-confidence capacity rows from secondary reporting.

source_title: Finland Data Centres - Sustainable Data Centre
evidence_excerpt: atNorth lists FIN02 in Espoo with 40MW total power capacity and Q1 2025 operations.
notes: Site-specific FIN02 page confirms Sinimäentie, Espoo. Treat 40 MW as facility-level power capacity.

source_title: Myllykoski data center - sustainable data centers
evidence_excerpt: atNorth's FIN04 Myllykoski page says the campus will have 430MW power capacity.
notes: Specific FIN04 page currently says 430 MW, while the broader Finland locations page still says 180 MW. Current source is a marketing/site page; refresh for construction-start or committed-build evidence before treating investment decision as yes.

source_title: Nebius to Construct 310 MW AI Factory in Finland
evidence_excerpt: Nebius says its Mäntsälä data center expansion to 75MW was completed earlier in 2026.
notes: Existing Nebius site; include as FI discovery because no FI master rows exist yet. Capacity basis is not IT-specific in the source.

source_title: Nebius to Construct 310 MW AI Factory in Finland
evidence_excerpt: Nebius announced a new Lappeenranta AI factory with capacity up to 310MW.
notes: Source says first capacity is expected in 2027. It does not explicitly qualify the 310 MW as IT load.

source_title: News: Verne unveils plans for sustainable data center campus in Finland
evidence_excerpt: Verne announced a 10-hectare Mäntsälä campus with initial capacity of 70MW.
notes: Source says construction would commence in mid-2025 and take two years, but current construction status was not independently refreshed in this pass.

project_name: XTX Markets Kajaani data centre complex
source_title: XTX Markets plans to invest over €1bn in large-scale data centre project in Kajaani Finland
evidence_excerpt: Kajaani city says XTX has begun construction of its first datacenter with 22.5MW of IT power.
notes: First datacenter is one phase of a larger same-site complex with four additional datacenters intended later. Only the 22.5 MW first datacenter has a public MW claim here.

source_title: Construction of the LUMI-AI data center in full swing
evidence_excerpt: CSC says construction work inside the former paper mill began in January 2026.
notes: Public research/HPC facility to host LUMI-AI and LUMI-IQ. No public MW claim found in this source.

source_title: Borealis Data Center's Kajaani campus is delivered in record time with project management services
evidence_excerpt: Sweco says Borealis' Kajaani facility was completed in 2025 at Renforsin Ranta.
notes: Project source confirms completion and colocation/HPC-AI character. Capacity claim uses separate trade/fact-sheet evidence.
